mo_ta_cong_viec:
ANDPAD Vietnam is looking for a QA Manager who is a strategic leader responsible for defining and driving the overall quality roadmap in alignment with our Japan HQ. Working within a dynamic Squad-based environment, you will not only oversee high-standard testing operations but also shape the organizational culture by integrating QA processes into every stage of the SDLC. Your mission is to build a high-performing QA organization that balances speed and quality, ensuring our products deliver exceptional value to users.
Job Scope
Develop and drive QA strategies for multiple teams or the entire organization in alignment with the Japan QA organization.
Manage and develop members, ensuring high performance and professional expertise.
Identify organizational challenges and implement continuous improvement measures.
Communicate closely with dev teams and management to ensure QA processes are integrated organizationally.
Provide stakeholders with continuous updates on QA activities, risks, and product quality.
Conduct performance evaluations.
Manage resources and drive recruitment activities.
Development environment
Automation test: Autify, Magicpod
Backend: Ruby (on Rails), Go, Amazon Aurora(MySQL), Elasticsearch, DynamoDB
FrontEnd: Nuxt.js/Vue.js, ReactJS
Mobile App: Kotlin, Swift, Flutter
Deploy/ Build: CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
Others: Swagger, Docker, Figma, Confluence, JIRA, esa

Communication skills in English

Continuous Learning Mindset: A self-driven learner who continuously explores and adopts new technologies and methodologies to stay updated
